baseline.title: Production Model-Serving Stack

nodes.label: Serving API
nodes.description: Accepts inference requests, authenticates callers, runs the active released model version, and returns responses with version metadata for traceability.

nodes.label: Model release service
nodes.description: Owns the release lifecycle: curates versioned evaluation evidence including hostile traces, runs offline evaluation, publishes reviewed immutable releases, and controls canary, promotion, rollback, and recorded outcomes.

nodes.label: Serving Monitor
nodes.description: Collects serving metrics, latency and error signals, and canary outcome data; raises alerts when released model health degrades.

nodes.label: Serving alert notifier
nodes.description: Receives degradation alerts from the Serving Monitor and routes acknowledged, deduplicated alert notifications to on-call operators with correlated model version and canary context.

assumptions: Serving API answers inference requests only; it does not propose or execute model-selected actions.
Model release service owns offline evaluation and release decisions; training pipelines are out of scope.
Monitoring observes and alerts but does not change model releases.

internals.label: Inference request executor
internals.description: Runs authenticated requests on the active version under a concurrency cap, applies timeouts and bounded retries, and returns typed errors with version metadata.

internals.label: Version activation controller
internals.description: Applies canary, promote, and rollback commands to the local active-version pointer by compare-and-set, dedupes by operation ID, and replies applied or rejected.

internals.label: Release state machine
internals.description: Authoritative owner of release lifecycle state; validates allowed transitions with optimistic versioning and permits one in-flight transition per serving target.

internals.label: Release command dispatcher
internals.description: Sends transition commands with stable operation IDs, retries with bounded backoff, reads back the active version on uncertain outcomes, and escalates after the limit.
